phase_mapping.phase1_setup: Phase 1: mature funds, plot funding, UNASSIGNED, empty mempool
phase_mapping.phase2_assignment: Phase 2: assignment RPC, mempool txid, confirmation, ASSIGNING, empty mempool, all four activation boundaries, ASSIGNED, 6a2c504f4358 OP_RETURN prefix
phase_mapping.phase3_revocation: Phase 3: refund, revocation RPC, mempool txid, REVOKING, empty mempool, all eight revocation boundaries, REVOKED, 6a1858434f50 OP_RETURN prefix
phase_mapping.phase4_single_state_rollback: Phase 4: invalidate each state transition, state and signer checks, returned mempool transactions, reconsider original chain
phase_mapping.phase5_multi_state_rollback: Phase 5: REVOKED to ASSIGNED to UNASSIGNED, reconsider with descendants back to REVOKED
phase_mapping.phase6_historic_verification: Phase 6: all five historical states with original heights and expected signer

feature_pocx_assignment_lifecycle.py.duplicate_aliases: Original ASSIGNING/ASSIGNED_CONFIRMED and REVOKING/REVOKED_CONFIRMED are identical block hashes; conversion stores each hash once without losing a transition assertion.
